title: Can LLMs Faithfully Solve Ontology Engineering Tasks? A Mechanistic Interpretability Study
summary: Distributed subspace interventions achieve the strongest ontology-task results but do not fully separate target relations from auxiliary class information. Matched interchange interventions are evaluated on two ontology tasks and Qwen 4B/8B; partial disentanglement is explicitly retained as a limitation. The result is reported in the arXiv preprint. Affiliation was not stated in the reviewed material. It does not establish generalization beyond the reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
ai_technology: Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B are tested with SAE, DBM and DAS interchange interventions on entity-typing and subsumption tasks.
